item.title: Greetings from Paris, where an art installation transformed the Pont Neuf into a rocky cave
item.description: The oldest bridge in Paris was draped in fabric last month to appear like a mountain cave, in an installation by the artist JR. Unlike a real cave, though, it didn't provide respite from a brutal heat wave.

item.title: The U.S. launches another wave of strikes on Iran as the Hormuz standoff intensifies

item.title: Ebola is spreading faster in eastern Congo than it can be tracked, as deaths pass 700
item.description: Eighty percent of new Ebola cases in eastern Congo are emerging from unknown chains of transmission, according to WHO, a sign the outbreak is spreading faster than health officials can track.
